comments.author: Sianyde
comments.body_html:
Error is fixed and posted as a hotfix. Either redownload the mod and copy+paste over existing files, or you can just go into db/Items and open both .json files (preferrably with Visual Studio Code.)

Ctrl+F and find “AddtoBots:”. There’s one instance for both guns that I mistakenly left on as ‘true’ and is causing the errors. Change ‘true’ to ‘false’ and that’ll fix the issue.

comments.author: kiester kid
comments.body_html:
Hey, I’ve had the same issue myself - the dubiously-helpful search function in this site makes things like this a bit difficult sometimes.

However, there is a more elegant solution:

Up at the top of the page, the blue box that says “Due to an unusually high volume of traffic…” has a link towards the end pointing to forge.sp-tarkov.com, an alternative version of the site with a much more useful search function. Just putting “WTT” into the search bar there pulls up all the mods labeled as being part of the Welcome to Tarkov collection.

Hope this was helpful. I imagine the Forge will become the default version of the site in the future - it is apparently under development right now, but seems to be functional for browsing and downloading mods.
